title: Extract duplicated row formatting
description: `src/report.py` repeats the same row-formatting expression in three functions. Extract it into one module-level helper `format_row(name, amount)` and make `render_sales`, `render_costs` and `render_summary` use it. The rendered output must not change.
success_criteria: Output identical to the original for hidden inputs; format_row exists, is called by all three functions, and the formatting expression occurs exactly once.
